activeVersion.name: Transport fix: UTF-8 byte length for callback_data
activeVersion.description: callback_data was checked with JS string length (UTF-16 units); Telegram enforces 1-64 UTF-8 bytes, so Cyrillic/emoji payloads could pass validation and then be rejected by Telegram. Now measured via TextEncoder with an encodeURIComponent fallback. Button text bound raised from 64 to 128 chars so that legitimate long Russian button labels are not falsely rejected.
